lines.beaver_en: Do you have a goal in life these days?
lines.learner: 네, 보람 있는 삶을 사는 게 목표예요.
lines.en: Yes, my goal is to live a rewarding life.
lines.roman: ne, boram inneun salmeul saneun ge mokpyoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 생각이에요. 어떤 일이 보람 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Good thinking. What kind of work feels rewarding?
lines.beaver_roman: joeun saenggagieyo. eotteon iri boram isseoyo?
lines.learner: 고생해도 남을 돕는 일은 할 만해요.
lines.en: Even if it's hard, helping others is worth doing.
lines.roman: gosaenghaedo nameul domneun ireun hal manhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is your private life okay with that work?
lines.en: I sometimes make sacrifices, but no regrets.

lines.beaver_en: That's impressive. Do you have a special wish?
lines.learner: 가족과 건강하게 사는 게 제 소원이에요.
lines.en: My wish is to live healthily with my family.
lines.roman: gajokgwa geonganghage saneun ge je sowonieyo.

lines.beaver: 그것도 큰 복이죠. 왜 그렇게 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: That's a great blessing too. Why do you think so?
lines.beaver_roman: geugeotdo keun bogijyo. wae geureoke saenggakaeyo?
lines.en: Because my grandma passed away last year.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, that must have been hard. You were very sad, right?
lines.learner: 네, 그때 삶이 짧다는 걸 알았어요.
lines.en: Yes, that's when I realized life is short.
lines.roman: ne, geuttae salmi jjalttaneun geol arasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So that's why you live harder.
lines.en: Life is only once, so it's worth taking on challenges.

lines.beaver: 가치관과 삶의 의미에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about values and the meaning of life?
lines.beaver_roman: gachigwangwa salmui uimie daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Sure. I'd like to hear about your experience too.

lines.beaver_en: I started my current job by chance.
lines.en: But your hard work has paid off, right?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. I really enjoyed our talk today.
lines.en: Me too. Thank you for your kind words.
